value.title: Course decision product
value.summary: Turn observed course facts and student-owned planning state into trustworthy decisions.
definition_of_done: Students can explore, inspect, save, label, compare, and plan from explicit evidence states.

value.title: Autonomous studio coordination
value.summary: Compose project goals, bounded actors, effects, evidence, and accepted transitions recursively.
definition_of_done: A portfolio goal can decompose into governed project and feature executions with durable receipts.

value.title: Codex native-session observation
value.summary: Preserve an honestly observed resumable native Codex session through the stable lifecycle facade.
definition_of_done: A real Codex lifecycle reports its native session when observed and preserves unknown when it cannot be warranted.

value.title: Managed supervisor wake channel
value.summary: Deliver warranted child idle, blocked, and terminal transitions to a resumable supervisor without per-child polling.
definition_of_done: A supervisor reconnects by stable identity and receives ordered, resumable child-state notifications through a typed channel.

value.title: Fleet resource observations and leases
value.summary: Publish synchronized machine observations and atomically admit registered task identities against finite resource pools.
definition_of_done: All harness adapters observe the same fresh resource facts and cannot obtain a partial resource vector or a second lease beyond a registered pool.
The interface states that lease admission does not prove execution while ordinary shell launch remains available.

value.title: Durable E2E execution environment
value.summary: Provide one durable queued browser environment that executes accepted journey requests and returns exact receipts.
definition_of_done: Concurrent callers enqueue typed journeys into one bounded executor and receive durable outcome receipts without sharing mutable browser state.

value.title: Stable Herdr agent facade
value.summary: Expose stable identities, typed lifecycle operations, exact waits, and durable supervisor observations.
definition_of_done: Callers can create, message, wait for, inspect, suspend, and resume native harness sessions through typed operations.

value.title: Subscription-backed supervisor runtime
value.summary: Model callers as stable supervisors of native-harness child actors with durable state notification.
definition_of_done: A supervisor reconnects by stable identity and receives warranted child state transitions without polling every child.

value.title: Transparent environment runtime
value.summary: Materialize harness-neutral environments whose declarations, observations, authority, reservations, and outcomes remain separately inspectable.
definition_of_done: Every fleet member sees the same typed environment identity, facilities, limits, live facts, missing facts, and published limitations.
Each mutable resource has one owning serialization point and all other views are freshness-bounded projections.

value.title: Mastra composition preview
value.summary: Provide a deployed bounded environment for evaluating Mastra composition workflows.
definition_of_done: The preview deploys reproducibly and records observed composition capabilities and limits.

value.title: Bounded Effect resource tracer
value.summary: Trace declared recurring resource drift and fan-out hazards without claiming heap reachability proof.
definition_of_done: The tracer preserves unknown and assumed boundaries and enforces named semantic budgets.

value.title: Reusable repository shape
value.summary: Compose versioned domain policies, capabilities, generators, migrations, agent guidance, and conformance gates into the PBK program shape.
definition_of_done: A repository can adopt and update a versioned PBK shape while retaining explicit local ownership and deviations.
One declarative profile drives an interactive builder, a typed programmatic API, non-interactive agent input, and deterministic generated artifacts.
Frontend profiles deploy to Cloudflare Workers through Alchemy v2, while Bun remains the local package and task runtime.
Every frontend profile installs Axe and escalates tests from Vitest to Browser Mode to Playwright at explicit behavior boundaries.
Reef can audit and reconcile an existing repository through versioned migrations, exception records, and evidence without erasing local product decisions.
Generator backends are adapters; Nx generators are evaluated first, while non-Nx repositories remain supported.

value.title: Phone-first Semantic Control Room
value.summary: Reconstruct the project Control Room as a content-addressed, freshness-aware public PWA.
definition_of_done: The accepted Semantic snapshot is usable on phone and exposes exact provenance, freshness, work, and evidence.

value.title: Agent-facing kernel JSON
value.summary: Implement the frozen closed JSON representation and bounded custody envelope for the kernel language.
definition_of_done: Agents can decode, validate, canonicalize, and execute the frozen kernel JSON interface under exact bounds.

value.title: Semantic language kernel
value.summary: Establish a small explicit kernel that lowers cleanly to the intended CBPV machine.
definition_of_done: Kernel programs have a frozen external representation, checked semantics, and executable lowering evidence.

value.title: Kernel reference interpreter
value.summary: Execute the frozen kernel interface through a small reference semantics with explicit bounded observations.
definition_of_done: Valid kernel programs evaluate deterministically and invalid programs preserve the frozen diagnostic and observation boundaries.
The public API, portable facts, proxy observations, and all acceptance gates survive independent review.

value.title: Kernel diagnostic-fact custody correction
value.summary: Restore the frozen type and label reference semantics for rejected checker observations so every interpreter outcome crosses its own canonical boundary.
definition_of_done: Type-valued and row-valued diagnostic facts register through the existing strict table-reference decoder and reject malformed or dangling references.
Generated invalid programs and a byte-exact cross-host fixture prove that every returned rejection satisfies the public guard and canonical encoders.

value.title: Optimized kernel compiler
value.summary: Lower kernel programs to the CBPV machine after the reference interpreter fixes executable meaning.
definition_of_done: Property-generated valid and invalid programs produce equivalent observable results through the reference interpreter and optimized compiler.

value.title: PBK portfolio Control Room
value.summary: Project the portfolio as queryable Board, Features, graph Roadmap, Mosaic, History, and detail views.
definition_of_done: All portfolio views derive from one strict model and preserve dependency, priority, evidence, and history meaning.

value.title: Surface language grammar
value.summary: Design the readable surface language and Pratt-parsed grammar that elaborates to the frozen kernel interface.
definition_of_done: One complete grammar parses, preserves source structure, and elaborates through explicit correspondence evidence.

value.title: Workgraph product journeys
value.summary: Close the deliberately red 0002 journeys for the local-first evidence-bound work graph.
definition_of_done: All frozen 0002 user journeys pass without weakening evidence or projection custody.
